Package com.irurueta.navigation.inertial

Class KalmanFilteredEstimatorTrajectory

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.navigation.inertial.KalmanFilteredEstimatorTrajectory
final class KalmanFilteredEstimatorTrajectory extends Object
Ground-truth trajectory used by the tests of the Kalman filtered estimators. A trajectory is a list of true ECEF frames sampled at a constant rate, along with the error-free body kinematics (specific force and angular rate) an ideal IMU would measure between each pair of consecutive frames. Sample i of the trajectory corresponds to time i * sampleInterval; kinematics i are the ones measured between frames i and i + 1.

    • fromSpeedAndHeading

      static KalmanFilteredEstimatorTrajectory fromSpeedAndHeading(com.irurueta.navigation.frames.NEDPosition initialPosition, double sampleInterval, double duration, DoubleUnaryOperator speed, DoubleUnaryOperator heading)
      Creates a level trajectory at constant height from a speed and a heading profile. The body keeps zero roll and pitch and its yaw equals the heading, the velocity points along the heading, and latitude and longitude are obtained by integrating the velocity so that the true position and the true velocity are consistent.
      Parameters:
      initialPosition - position at the start of the trajectory.
      sampleInterval - sample interval expressed in seconds.
      duration - duration of the trajectory expressed in seconds.
      speed - function returning the horizontal speed expressed in meters per second for a time expressed in seconds.
      heading - function returning the heading expressed in radians for a time expressed in seconds.
      Returns:
      a new trajectory.

    • chainNavigator

      static com.irurueta.navigation.frames.ECEFFrame chainNavigator(com.irurueta.navigation.frames.ECEFFrame initialFrame, List<BodyKinematics> kinematicsList, double sampleInterval) throws InertialNavigatorException
      Navigates from an initial frame by chaining one call to ECEFInertialNavigator.navigateECEF(double, ECEFFrame, BodyKinematics, ECEFFrame) per kinematics sample. This is the oracle of the tests checking that an estimator integrates every IMU sample.
      Parameters:
      initialFrame - frame at the start. It is not modified.
      kinematicsList - kinematics measured during each consecutive sample interval.
      sampleInterval - sample interval expressed in seconds.
      Returns:
      frame obtained after integrating all the samples.
      Throws:
      InertialNavigatorException - if navigation fails due to numerical instabilities.
